verdict.rationale: Figma's Dev Mode (referenced via figma-docs-23 'Advanced Dev Mode inspection') and Code Connect (figma-gh-1, showing true-to-production code snippets) plus the REST API's ability to 'view and extract any objects or layers, and their properties from files' (figma-docs-49/7/26) support layer inspection, measurements, and code snippet retrieval outside full editing. Community comments (figma-comm-1, figma-comm-2, figma-comm-4) confirm real-world use of CSS/asset export and note Dev Mode is a separate license tier (implying no full editor seat needed) but also flag friction points like manual SVG export and CSS-only snippet limitations. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of iOS/Android code snippet formats, confirmation that Dev Mode requires no editor seat, and independent validation that all asset types are inspectable without one.
